dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Alas, I caused you all a lot of trouble before. If that young Gaming fellow hadn't rescued me, I'm afraid these old bones would already be part of the mountains..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The wild beasts seem to be more active than usual recently. Considering your age, you should try not to go too deep into the mountains alone unless you really have to."
